control.description-key: A fully configurable rating control with dynamic title, custom colors, half-star precision, hover labels and keyboard support.

property.name: title
property.description-key: The heading text shown above the rating (leave blank to hide)

property.name: shape
property.description-key: Choose the shape for the rating control

property.name: color
property.description-key: Choose the color for the rating control, or pick Custom to use your own hex color

property.name: customColor
property.description-key: Hex color used when Rating Color is set to Custom, e.g. #FF6B00

property.name: maxRating
property.description-key: Number of icons to display (e.g. 5 or 10)

property.name: size
property.description-key: Choose the size of the rating icons

property.name: showCounter
property.description-key: Show the numeric value (e.g. 3 / 5) below the icons

property.name: showLabels
property.description-key: Show a text label (e.g. Excellent) that matches the hovered or selected value

property.name: labels
property.description-key: Comma separated labels matching each rating level, e.g. Poor,Fair,Good,Very Good,Excellent

property.name: allowClear
property.description-key: Clicking the currently selected icon again resets the rating to 0

property.name: readOnly
property.description-key: Display the rating without allowing the user to change it

property.name: enableAnimation
property.description-key: Play a subtle pop animation when a rating is selected
